title: AI in Daily Life and Industry
learningObjectives: Give examples of how AI is used in daily life and various industries.
Explain what AI is good at and what requires caution when using AI.
guidingQuestion: Where is AI used in daily life and industry, what is AI good at, and what needs caution?

sections.title: 1. Use of AI in Daily Life

blocks.text: (1) Various AI technologies are already in use around us.

rows: Predict preferences from past behavior data and display recommendations.
Recognize a voice, understand commands, and execute them.
Automatically translate text into different languages.
Automatically detect and identify human faces in photographs.

blocks.text: (1) AI technologies are also being introduced in various industries.

rows: Image-diagnosis AI (detecting diseases from X-ray and CT images), drug-discovery support
Predicting harvest timing, detecting pests and diseases
Automation of product quality inspection, predictive maintenance

blocks.text: Four industries where AI is used

sections.title: 3. Characteristics of AI and Cautions for Use

blocks.text: Finding and classifying patterns in complex data such as images and text Recognition and generation of images, audio, and text
Probabilistic reasoning and prediction based on data
(2) What requires caution when using AI
Ethical judgments (may lead to discrimination or prejudice)
Judgments involving personal information or privacy
Final decision-making (who is responsible for the result)
Accuracy of judgments when training data is biased
Generating content that differs from the facts (hallucination)
Issues of rights when using copyrighted works as training data
Loss of clarity about how a judgment was made (the black-box problem)
